items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: He reminded me of Louis Frumman who was doing all kinds of humbug.

ctx.x: He asked, we've got an interview with him. Yeah.

But Maris and Rapola. But you couldn't make out much what Armstrong said last night. He reminded me of Louis Frumman who was doing all kinds of humbug. And then we had a lot of small bands. And then it was, the movies were silent up until 1926 when we had talking pictures, I think. It was a year after my last child was born. And Lowest State used to have Waterville and the Sanger.
